description: Big clouds with always-free quotas or sign-up credits.

services.name: Amazon Web Services
services.description: New accounts get a credit-based free plan; 30+ services also stay free within monthly limits.
free_tier: Up to $200 in credits for new customers ($100 at sign-up, up to $100 more for exploring services)
Free plan account lasts up to 6 months or until credits run out
30+ services are always free within monthly usage limits

services.name: Google Cloud
services.description: Always-free monthly quotas across Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, BigQuery and Firestore, plus a sign-up credit.
free_tier: 1 e2-micro VM per month (us-west1, us-central1 or us-east1) with 30 GB-months standard disk
Cloud Run: 2M requests, 360,000 GB-seconds and 180,000 vCPU-seconds per month
Cloud Storage: 5 GB-months regional storage in US regions
BigQuery: 1 TiB of queries and 10 GiB storage per month
Firestore: 1 GiB storage, 50K reads / 20K writes / 20K deletes per day
New accounts: $300 credit valid for 90 days
services.notes: Google may change free tier limits with 30 days' notice.

services.name: Microsoft Azure
services.description: Sign-up credit, 12 months of popular services and 65+ always-free services.
free_tier: $200 credit to use in the first 30 days
Free monthly amounts of popular services for 12 months (new customers only)
65+ services with free monthly amounts for as long as you have an account
services.notes: Move to pay-as-you-go within 30 days to keep the 12-month services.

services.name: Oracle Cloud Free Tier
services.description: Always Free resources including Arm (Ampere A1) and AMD compute, block and object storage and Autonomous Database.
free_tier: Always Free: Arm-based Ampere A1 compute and AMD-based compute
Always Free: Block Volume and Object Storage
Always Free: Autonomous Database (Data Warehouse, Transaction Processing, JSON)
services.notes: See Oracle's Always Free documentation for exact shapes and quotas.
